items.t: GE Vernova (GEV) Secures New Wind Turbine Order In Germany
items.sum: GE Vernova (NYSE:GEV) agreed a new onshore wind turbine supply deal in Germany with Stadtwerke Heidenheim. The contract expands GE Vernova’s installed base in the country and adds fresh volume to its German onshore wind backlog.
